specific_objectives: 28.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the need for explosive regulation

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of explosive storage regulations and identification of extrusion/exudation signs in lubricant containers; Instructor supervision required for safety checks.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of explosive regulation?
Define extrusion in the context of lubricants.
Why is radio hazard a concern for aircrew?

development.content:
Definition of Extrusion
Causes of Lubricant Extrusion
Definition of Exudation
Differences between Extrusion and Exudation
Impact on Aircraft Systems

Radioactive Contamination Sources
Types of Radioactive Hazards
Detection Methods for Radioactivity
Safety Protocols for Radioactive Materials
Regulatory Framework for Explosives

Consequences of Ignoring Regulations
Maintenance Procedures for Contaminated Parts
Reporting Procedures for Hazards
Review of Explosive Storage Rules
Summary of Key Safety Points

summary_questions: Explain how extrusion affects the integrity of fuel systems.
Describe the steps to take if radioactivity is detected on an aircraft component.
Why is strict adherence to explosive regulations critical for aircrew safety?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the importance of monitoring lubricant extrusion and exudation in aircraft maintenance, referencing relevant regulatory guidelines.

pft_rows.syllabus: Categories of explosives, Various groups of explosives based on fire risk, explosion and hazard risk.
